notes.title: DRAGONOID - DevLog 04
notes.content:
Hello Everyone this is [b]MetaBite Gamez[/b] ,

The wind whispered across the open field, bending the tall grass like waves upon a restless sea. Beneath the watchful, veiled gaze of the moon, an egg lay nestled in the cool earth—alone, abandoned, yet pulsing with an eerie sense of purpose.

Its shell, smooth yet marked with strange, vein-like patterns, glistened faintly in the dim light. A faint warmth radiated from within, a quiet heartbeat in the stillness of the night.

The world held its breath. Was this [b]egg[/b] truly forgotten, or had it been placed here for a reason? And if so… what manner of creature lay sleeping inside, waiting for the moment to awaken?

Hello Everyone this is [b]MetaBite Gamez[/b] ,

Indeed, every great tale begins with but a whisper—a spark of hope or a glimmer of ambition. The grandest of heroes often start as humble figures, their lives woven from simple threads before they find themselves swept into the weave of destiny. . 

Ah, yes—hidden away from the well-trodden paths, where the sun filters through thick canopies, lies a small, weathered hut. Moss grows thickly upon its roof, and ivy crawls along the walls, giving it an ancient and almost forgotten look. The hut sits in a small clearing, surrounded by towering oaks and whispering pines, as if nature itself guards its secrets..

notes.content:
Hello Everyone this is [b]MetaBite Gamez[/b] ,

we are happy to kickstart [b]DRAGONOID - DevLog [/b]where we will post development progress for the game up until its release . 

what's [b]DRAGONOID [/b]you say ? 
a classic turn-based RPG set in a world, brimming with magic, creatures, and epic quests. Players assume the role of GAI, a young hero destined to become a legendary monk, accompanied by his companions . Each ,with unique abilities and backgrounds .
